data.long_meaning: Marwanah is derived from the Arabic word 'marwan', meaning 'to hope' or 'to aspire'. In Islamic tradition, this name signifies the belief in the unwavering promise of Allah and the hope for eternal paradise. The name Marwanah carries the meaning “Hope, Aspiration” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Marwanah usually hope their child will grow to embody hope, aspiration and live with faith, good character and purpose.
